Internal, competitive research. Not for distribution outside Paradigm Life.

Garrett Gunderson marketing system: competitive teardown

Whole Life Certified, Legacy Method and the Rockefeller book, Multiplier Family Office, Money Unmasked, Wealth Factory (now under Norm Westervelt), and X1 Wealth

Prepared for Paradigm Life by Dan Torsak, COO · Oct 20, 2026 · For Rachel, John, and leadership

Companion draft: Paradigm Life playbook: adapting what works (DRAFT for collaboration)

Confirmed seen on a live page, ad, or board capture Inferred our reading, not confirmed Unknown could not be checked
On this page
1. TL;DR 2. Brand map 3. Funnel flows 4. Ads: Meta and Google 5. Video and tools stack 6. Content cadence 7. Messaging and compliance 8. Implications and options 9. Open questions 10. Sources

1 TL;DR

  • Garrett sold Wealth Factory and says he is no longer affiliated with it. It is now led by Norm Westervelt. Garrett's current business is Multiplier Family Office (launched July 2024), a coordinated offer ("one point person, one coordinated team, and one clear plan") for business owners earning $350K+ per year. That positioning competes directly with our Family Office 360 and Wealth Strategy Team.[3, 41, 23, 24]
  • Paid media is Meta-heavy. On Oct 20, 2026 the US Meta Ad Library showed about 35 active results for "Garrett Gunderson" and about 9 for "Legacy Method". Google Ads Transparency showed 0 ads for all five domains we checked (US region).[70, 71, 94]
  • Three offers carry the paid traffic right now: a free Money Unmasked book, the "What Would the Rockefellers Do?" book (free, pay shipping, via Legacy Method), and the Multiplier 8-minute overview and application. A new batch of about 15 "Multiplier Reviews" testimonial videos started Oct 9 to 11.[94]
  • Creative is Garrett on camera, real footage, long-form first-person copy. Ad videos run from 0:21 to 44:51. We found no AI avatars or AI voice in his ads or Shorts (note: ad videos were not played).[94, 93]
  • Whole Life Certified (WLC) is an agent-lead destination with no ads of its own. Its one conversion point is a find-an-agent form that asks age, income, and net worth. Garrett also offers a licensing program for whole life agents (book foreword, funnels, GoHighLevel CRM).[33, 72, 5]
  • Organic is a steady engine: heavy YouTube Shorts output, a weekly Tax Tip Tuesday livestream, a Sunday newsletter, and a podcast relaunched Oct 15, 2026, with YouTube links tagged by UTM into Multiplier and Tax Navigator funnels.[50, 17, 18, 53, 51]

2 Brand map: who owns what

8 Implications and possible next steps

Options for discussion, not decisions.

1

Head-to-head brief: Multiplier vs Family Office 360

Multiplier sells the same promise we do (one coordinated team, one point person, a findings report) to $350K+ owners, and is now its main paid focus. A one-page comparison would help sales and marketing answer "how are you different?" Pricing and deliverables on their side are not public, so the brief would be positioning-only.[23, 24]

2

Test the 4321 whitepaper or WealthScore as a free offer, in his format

His working pattern: long-form first-person copy, founder on camera, contrarian hooks ("Budgeting is one of the most expensive financial lies..."), and a testimonial set ("Multiplier Reviews"). A small Meta test of our own offer in that style is one option, with human creative review before anything runs.[94]

3

Monthly Ad Library watch

Re-run the saved Meta and Google searches (Sources section) once a month and log new hooks, offers, and start dates. The Oct 9 testimonial batch and Oct 2 Money Unmasked launch show they test in bursts.[94]

4

Keep our claims within the approved list

Several competitor pages use absolute language (section 7). Matching it is not the goal; our edge can be clear, compliant wording plus proof.

9 Open questions and gaps

  • Ad videos not watched. Content, AI use, and the "Multiplier Reviews" footage are judged from thumbnails and copy only.[94]
  • Spend not public. No US spend data in either library.[94]
  • Pricing unknown for Multiplier membership and for WLC agent certification or licensing terms and fees.[93]
  • Legacy Method page ID unresolved. view_all_page_id=61564961335995 returned "No ads match," likely a profile ID rather than the ad page ID. Owning entity also unknown.[79]
  • Google region retry. Re-run Transparency searches with region "anywhere" and search names such as RipWater, FreeFlow Group, and Multiplier.[94, 93]
  • Ad destination pages not captured: mu26-free-book, financial-life-made-easy-page, wealth-os-second-qualify, book-rof-now. Post-purchase steps after the Rockefeller book are unknown.
  • Unverified Wealth Factory page ID 107757321185127; Killing Sacred Cows and Garda Wealth Meta searches not yet run.[80, 77, 78]
  • Cadence gaps. Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and newsletter sends were not counted (sign-in needed), and TikTok activity since Jun 3 is unconfirmed.[55, 54, 66, 18]
  • Semrush paid search data unavailable (account out of API units).[93]
